Is it possible to copyright titles or names? No, copyright registration does not cover the covers of books, movie titles, brand or product names, short words, logos, and catchphrases. It protects unique literary pieces only What's the difference between Copyright registration and trademark registration? Trademark registration safeguards brand names, logos etc, while copyright protection applies to literary works, music, videos, and artistic content. What is the distinction between copyright registration and trademark registration? Trademark registration includes protection of brand names, and logos, while it is the copyright that protects non-literary, musical, video, and artistic works. How long does a copyright last? In India, copyright registration is valid for sixty years. For literary, drama, and music works, the validity gets measured from the death of the author while for other genres, like films, sound recordings, and photographs it starts from the date of publication. . Does copyright obtained in India protect the work in all the countries? Yes, as long as the work is done in India, it is protected under the Berne Convention. Thus, India too will form alliances with other nations that are part of the convention for its protection. Is it required to publish the work before registering for copyright? No, registration can be made for works that are both published and non-published. If the work is already published, publication details must be provided when applying.

sections.heading: Section 7
paragraphs: Copyright is the rights of ownership of literature, theater, music, art, sound recordings, and other creative works. Copyright registration gives the creator a bundle of rights which includes reproduction, public show, modification and translation of the work.

Copyright registration is a shield that protects the creators’ ownership and benefits from their creations and acknowledges the creative space. With the increasing awareness of intellectual property laws, there has been a huge increase in intellectual property registrations in India. Among the most important forms of intellectual property protection is copyright registration.
In India, it gives many benefits for creators and IP Owners:
For the Owner: Through Services Plus's online copyright registration in India, owner gets exclusive rights to reproduce, distribute, adapt, share and translate their work.
Strong Legal Cover: A valid copyright registration certificate ensures that work can’t be copied without owner’s permission.
Boosts Brand: A copyright registration is a proof of ownership and can be used in marketing to build brand and goodwill.
Global Protection: Once copyrighted in one country, same work is given similar rights in many other countries including India.
Treat Copyright as an Asset: Recognised as an intellectual property asset, Copyright can be sold and adds financial value to the creator’s portfolio.
Increased Visibility for the Owner: Works having copyright registration are more visible, globally available and easily traceable in copyright databases. This visibility will deter potential misuse.
Financial Security: Copyright enables financial stability by allowing creators to diversify and monetize their content and have recurring income streams.
Documents Requirement for Copyright Based on Work Type:
Two digital copies of the artwork.
No Objection Certificate (NOC) issued by the applicant.
NOC from the publisher (if the work is published and the publisher is not the applicant).
Find Certificate issued by the Registrar of Trademarks.

Is it possible to copyright titles or names?
No, copyright registration does not cover the covers of books, movie titles, brand or product names, short words, logos, and catchphrases. It protects unique literary pieces only
What's the difference between Copyright registration and trademark registration?
Trademark registration safeguards brand names, logos etc, while copyright protection applies to literary works, music, videos, and artistic content.
What is the distinction between copyright registration and trademark registration?
Trademark registration includes protection of brand names, and logos, while it is the copyright that protects non-literary, musical, video, and artistic works.
How long does a copyright last?

In India, copyright registration is valid for sixty years. For literary, drama, and music works, the validity gets measured from the death of the author while for other genres, like films, sound recordings, and photographs it starts from the date of publication. .
Does copyright obtained in India protect the work in all the countries?
Yes, as long as the work is done in India, it is protected under the Berne Convention. Thus, India too will form alliances with other nations that are part of the convention for its protection.
Is it required to publish the work before registering for copyright?
No, registration can be made for works that are both published and non-published. If the work is already published, publication details must be provided when applying.
